description: This file contains unit tests for the LicenseDao class within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin's DAO layer. It tests CRUD operations, existence checks, and retrieval functions related to the License entity.

classes.name: LicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A test suite for the LicenseDao class, focusing on CRUD operations and verification of license data handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LicenseDao instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testAddLicense
methods.description: Tests the addition of a new License entity.

methods.name: testEditLicense
methods.description: Tests updating an existing License entity.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a License by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of License entities based on search filters.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete a non-existent License record.

methods.name: testIsExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks existence of License names with various casing and whitespace.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves License entities by name, testing case insensitivity and trimming.
